shellCommands.command: git status && git diff && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100

for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json lib/projects.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx __agent_eval__/run.mjs .gitignore; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done; ls node_modules/next/package.json && node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version)"

grep -o '"cacheComponents"[^,]*' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head -3; grep -rn "cacheLife\b" node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/cache-life.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/cache.js 2>/dev/null; grep -n "export" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts | head

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && echo "--- guest ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '<main>.*</main>' && echo && echo "--- member ---" && curl -s -H 'Cookie: member=Ada; team=Platform' -H 'x-region: eu-west' http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '<main>.*</main>' && echo && echo "--- prerendered shell ---" && grep -oE '<main>.*</main>' .next/server/app/index.html; pkill -f "next start" ; true

(npx next start -p 3124 > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; echo "--- guest streamed ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3124/ | grep -oE '
.*?
' ; echo; echo "--- member streamed ---"; curl -s -H 'Cookie: member=Ada; team=Platform' -H 'x-region: eu-west' http://localhost:3124/ | grep -oE '
.*?
'; echo; kill $(pgrep -f "next start" | grep -v $$) 2>/dev/null; true
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; git status --short; git diff tsconfig.json

printf 'node_modules/
.next/
__agent_eval__/
' > .gitignore && npx next build 2>&1 | grep -E "Cache Components|Compiled|error|Error|◐|○|Partial" ; git status --short
